name: Alkaid
description: A dwarf of type B3 V 31.9 parsecs away, 3.4 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the Navy Precision Optical Interferometer.

radius.source: Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 120315: radius 3.4 +/- 0.5 solar radii (Table 5), from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.981 +/- 0.144 mas (NPOI, Table 4) and the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax

temperature.source: Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 120315: effective temperature 15540 +/- 1157 K (Table 5), from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux of the SED fit

gravity.source: Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 120315: log g 3.78, from Allende Prieto & Lambert (1999), as the paper lists it beside the diameter (Table 4)

distance.source: Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 120315: the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax the radius was computed with (Table 1), 31.38 +/- 0.24 mas, inverted

text.card: A dwarf of type B3 V, 32 parsecs away: 3.4 times the Sun's width and 594 times its light.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 0.981 milliarcseconds, which gives 3.4 solar radii and 15,540 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 1, 4 and 5, HD 120315: parallax, limb-darkened diameter, radius, Teff

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 1510374147844219904 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none
